terms.title: Terms of service
s: 1 · Who we are
esy.ge is a platform where anyone can open a shop.
esy does not sell goods. We give a merchant a place, a subdomain and tools. The contract of sale is between the buyer and the shop.
2 · Your account
One account covers both buying and selling.
You sign in with Google. There is no separate seller account — a shop attaches to an existing one. A verified phone is required before paying and before opening a shop.
3 · Opening a shop
It is free, and there is no subscription.
The subdomain is assigned at creation and cannot change afterwards. Platform names — including manager — are reserved and cannot be registered as a shop.
4 · The fee
esy takes 2% of a sale. Nothing else.
The fee is frozen onto the order at creation and paid once a month on a single statement. Refunded orders are excluded. Card processing fees belong to the bank.
5 · Prohibited items
Illegal or dangerous goods are not allowed.
esy may remove a product or suspend a shop. Suspension closes the storefront — the data remains.
6 · Liability
In a dispute esy mediates; the contract is between buyer and shop.
We help both sides reach a resolution and protect buyers against bad-faith behaviour.

privacy.title: Privacy
s: What we keep
Your name, email, phone and addresses.
This data is platform-level and works at every shop. We never store a password — sign-in goes through Google.
What a shop sees
Only what an order needs.
A shop sees your name, phone and delivery address — for the order you placed with it. It cannot see orders from other shops.
The address copy
Every order keeps its own.
An order stores the address as it was at purchase. Editing or deleting an address later does not change past orders.
Deletion
You can delete your account at any time.
Order history stays with the shop for accounting purposes; personal data is removed.

returns.title: Cancellations, returns, refunds
s: Cancelling as a buyer
You can, while the order is placed and unpaid.
Cancelling a paid order means a refund, which is a different operation — contact the shop in that case.
Cancelling as a shop
A shop can cancel at Placed or Shipped.
After delivery there is no cancellation — that is a return.
Returns
14 days from delivery.
The item must be unused and in its original condition. Start a return from the order page or by calling the shop.
Refunds
Money returns to the same card in 3–5 working days.
A refund does not change the fulfilment status: a delivered order can be refunded — that is normal, not a data error.
Disputes
Cannot agree? esy steps in.
Write to help@esy.ge. We hear both sides and decide within 5 working days.

Why do you need my phone?
